purpose: Verify that every distinct frozen requirement must produce accepted evidence before PASS and that duplicate or unknown executions cannot substitute for missing coverage.

expected.safe_condition: Missing frozen evidence must remain INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE/BLOCKED; duplicate or unknown requirement execution must not increase coverage; exact distinct full coverage may proceed.

limits: This test measures frozen requirement coverage accounting in MGnarf v1.70 at the exact target commit.
It does not establish that a PASS result from each valid verifier is substantively correct.
